description: Amme, Jonathan and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. Small MaStR generation units below 30 kW lack public coordinates but have postal-code and city fields. This deposit geocodes the observed postal-code/city combinations using Nominatim and supplies a GeoPackage associated with the February 2025 open-MaStR bulk snapshot. These are inferred postal locations, not surveyed plant coordinates. The boxed and unboxed registry exports describe the same underlying source snapshot and remain related existing-registry evidence. The derived geometry is a distinct data object for mapping energy inventory inputs. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of cc-by-4.0. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance. The derived locations support spatial analysis of the registered generation inventory.
